_comment: Reference wiring for the hooks in this directory. NOT read by anything —
Claude Code reads <workspace>/.claude/settings.json, which is machine-local
and holds absolute paths. This file exists so the wiring is recoverable:
when the hooks lived only in an untracked .claude/ directory, losing that
directory lost both the scripts and the knowledge of how they were hooked up.
Run scripts/hooks/install.sh to create the symlinks, then mirror the blocks
below into .claude/settings.json with your own absolute paths.

hooks._note: Acquires a file-level punchcard. Advisory by default; CRUX_PUNCH_MODE=enforce blocks. Exits 0 on any daemon error — a coordination outage must not become a workstation outage.
Releases the cards for the paths a git commit named, stamping release_commit_sha. Files edited but not committed stay held.
Exit 2 when a terminal fact is stored but the plan's Status: line still reads live.
Board-drift summary at boot. Set CRUX_HTTP_URL when the daemon binds a tailnet address — loopback silently no-ops there.
